utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning, everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-08-91-T, the Prosecutor versus Stanisic and Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone. May we have the appearances today, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: I'm so sorry, Your Honours. I was distracted by my case manager. It's Joanna Korner and Crispian Smith for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Slobodan Cvijetic, Slobodan Zecevic, and Eugene O'Sullivan appearing for Stanisic Defence today. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For Zupljanin Defence, Igor Pantelic, Dragan Krgovic, Eric Tully, and Ms. Katarina Danicic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: We have been alerted that both sides have some preliminary matter to raise.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I think, Your Honours, that with the approval of my learned friend Ms. Korner I will address you. It concerns a situation that we became aware of yesterday after receiving a motion by the OTP about scheduling videolinks for the beginning of next year. I assume that the Chamber is aware that the calendar of the Serbian Orthodox church is a so-called old calendar, which is 14 days delayed in relation to the regular calendar. I'm not sure whether it's Gregorian or Julian, but at any rate that is the situation we are facing. And according to the calendar of the Serbian Orthodox church, Christmas falls on the 7th of January and Serbian new year on the 14th of January. We have talked to our clients and they have asked us to address the Chamber, and we're also doing it not only on their behalf but also on our behalf to ask you not to sit in the courtroom on the 14th of January. Now, given that the Prosecution has proposed that there be a videolink on the 12th, 13th, and 14th of January, I have talked to Ms. Korner and other lawyers for the Prosecution. And as far as I could understand, it would be no problem for them if that videolink was to be postponed for sometime later, after the 17th of January. I therefore wanted to inform the Trial Chamber of this fact and ask you to make a ruling based on this. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Would a ruling be called for at this stage, or is this something that we can let the -- that we can think about over the next few days?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Your Honours, I believe what would be sufficient is that the Office of the Prosecutor is told that the Trial Chamber will think about this issue so they can schedule their videolink for the week after from Sarajevo, for week 18th of January. I think that was the -- that was the point why we brought it today so they don't -- they wouldn't have any problems in scheduling.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Your Honours, that's right. We don't require a decision today, but we would like one by the end of the week if that's possible so that we can schedule.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: Mrs. Korner and Zecevic, do you still plan to sit on Monday, the 11th; and Tuesday, the 12th; and actually Wednesday the 13th.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Well, we do. We're not asking for an adjournment at all, but we just wouldn't have videolink witnesses.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: Oh, right.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: As you saw in the motion we asked for the videolink for that week after discussions with Ms. Featherstone.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: If you decided that either the defendants needn't be here or one of the lawyers then we'd move the videolink. I think it's really a question of whether you grant either the adjournment or not.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: What I want to be sure about is that what is being asked is only that we do not sit on Thursday, the 14th. That's the only thing that is being asked.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: That's correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: I see.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: Nothing else.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Right, well, then --

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: That is correct, Your Honour, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: So we would sit Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and then not sit on Thursday, and then continuing sitting on Friday.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Just to make it clear, we're not asking for an adjournment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: No, but that was the clarification that I was seeking.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: No, but if Your Honours decide to grant the Defence application because we want to do all the videolink witnesses together, we'll move the videolink witnesses to another week.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Yes, we now move into closed session to continue the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 19th day of November, 2009, at 9.00 a.m. 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
